tasks.title: Promote the five staged migrations and extend the test support for keys, usage and time zone
tasks.dod: The five staged pairs are promoted into prisma/migrations, apply and revert cleanly on a throwaway database with no Prisma drift, and an integration test shows prisma.user.delete cascades PersonalKey, PersonalKeyUsageWeek and MCP_KEY limit rows.

tasks.title: Add the shared overdue rule module with its SQL, Prisma and TypeScript forms
tasks.dod: Unit tests for todayIn(zone), isOverdue and daysOverdue pass at the AC-23 and AC-23b instants under a fake clock, the equivalence test shows the SQL fragment, Prisma condition and TS predicate select the same invoices on one fixture, and the scanning test fails on a hand-written OVERDUE status check outside the module.

tasks.title: Generate, checksum and digest ifk_ Personal keys
tasks.dod: Unit tests show generated keys match ^ifk_[0-9A-Za-z]{49}$ with a valid 6-char checksum, a one-character change fails the checksum, digest is lower-case hex SHA-256 and lastFour is the last four characters, and parse rejects malformed input without touching any store.

tasks.title: Read the Freelancer time zone from the account in both ActingFreelancer factories and save it from settings
tasks.dod: Integration tests show the session factory seeds User.timeZone from a valid tz cookie only while it is NULL (a second seed affects 0 rows), uses UTC when nothing is saved or reported, ignores the cookie once a zone is saved, actingFreelancerFromPersonalKey uses the same column, and updateTimeZone saves a known zone and refuses an unknown one with TIME_ZONE_MESSAGE.

tasks.title: Add the Time zone card to Profile settings
tasks.dod: Component tests cover SCR-02 default, not-set, saving, success, validation (TIME_ZONE_MESSAGE verbatim) and FAILED/UNAUTHORIZED states, and the profile page renders the card under the existing profile card.

tasks.title: Apply the shared overdue rule to every dashboard figure and show tabs for issued-invoice currencies
tasks.dod: Integration tests show a past-due never-marked pending invoice counted in overdue figures, its Customer a Debtor, absent from Expected payments and shown Overdue in recent invoices; the AC-23 and AC-23b instants give the same result as the rule module; currency tabs are the union of bank-account and issued-invoice currencies; the existing dashboard parity test stays green.

tasks.title: Return the derived status from every invoice read and filter by the shared rule
tasks.dod: Integration tests show listInvoices, customer and sender-profile invoice lists, getInvoice and editor data return OVERDUE for a past-due pending invoice without writing the stored status, the OVERDUE filter includes it and PENDING leaves it out, updateInvoiceStatus refuses OVERDUE/PENDING on it with the D-6 message and still marks it PAID.

tasks.title: Show the derived overdue status on the invoice list, customer page, invoice page and recent invoices
tasks.dod: Component tests show a derived-overdue row with the Overdue badge and a menu without Mark as Overdue / Mark as Pending but with Mark as Paid, the status-rejected toast shows the D-6 message verbatim and refreshes the row, and the overdue literal scan from T02 passes with no allow-list entries left.

tasks.title: Create, list and revoke Personal keys through the business layer and server actions
tasks.dod: Integration tests cover create (fullKey once, never stored), the AC-03 name refusals incl. case-insensitive duplicate and P2002 mapping, the AC-04 10-active refusal under parallel creates, list split active/revoked createdAt DESC with no digest, revoke (owner-scoped, NOT_FOUND for another Freelancer's or a revoked key) and hasUsedAnyPersonalKey staying true after every key is revoked.

tasks.title: Add the per-key and per-source MCP limit scopes that fail closed
tasks.dod: Integration tests show the 61st counted call in the most recent 60 s refused with retryAt = oldest + 60 s while other keys pass, refused calls not counted, 30 refused key checks in 5 min block the source with retryAt = oldest + 5 min, MCP_KEY rows carry userId, and an unavailable store returns unavailable for both checks.

tasks.title: Authenticate a presented Personal key and record its last use and weekly usage
tasks.dod: Integration tests show a malformed key refused with no query, unknown/revoked/deleted-account keys return the same {ok:false}, a valid key yields an ActingFreelancer with the account zone or UTC, lastUsedAt is written at most once a minute, and recordPersonalKeyUsage upserts attempts/successes/assistantErrors atomically under two racing first calls and sets firstSuccessAt once.

tasks.title: Serve POST /api/mcp behind its single proxy exception with the source-limit, key-check and key-limit pipeline
tasks.dod: Integration tests on /api/mcp show the byte-identical 401 for missing/malformed/unknown/revoked/deleted-account keys and for a session cookie without a key, 429 with Retry-After for the key and source limits, 503 when the limit store is unavailable, 405 for GET/DELETE, no CORS headers, and a unit test pins /api/mcp as the only non-auth proxy exception.

tasks.title: Shape MCP answers, register read-only tools and count substantive calls
tasks.dod: Unit tests show page-size defaulting to 20 and capping at 50 with pageSizeCapped, ActionResult mapping to ToolError (VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND incl. PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE, AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE, FAILED), FreelancerText wrapping; contract tests show tools/list returns only readOnlyHint tools whose descriptions end with the data-not-instructions sentence, an unknown tool is -32602 and changes nothing, and each tools/call records exactly one usage outcome.

tasks.title: Page overdue invoices and Debtors strictly with totals over every match
tasks.dod: Integration tests show listOverdueInvoices returns the AC-12 rows with days overdue and per-currency totals over every overdue invoice, listDebtorsPage returns all nine Debtors across pages ranked per currency in agreement with getDebtors, a page past the last returns PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE with total and lastPage, and pageSize 1000 is capped at 50.

tasks.title: Page Expected payments by period and compute summary figures for every issued-invoice currency
tasks.dod: Integration tests show listExpectedPaymentsPage without a period equals the dashboard Expected payments totals and with this-month equals the planned figure, states period bounds and zone, getSummaryFiguresAllCurrencies equals getSummaryStats to the cent for every currency with countedBy per figure, and the three AC-16 period errors are refused with the AC-16 message.

tasks.title: Match Customers by current and invoice-copied names and search issued invoices for an Assistant
tasks.dod: Integration tests show the AC-17 search returns only issued invoices at most 50 per page with total matches and per-currency totals over every match, drafts and cancelled only when asked, the AC-21 rename finds both names case-insensitively, several matches return AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE, and another Freelancer's Customer or sender profile is answered exactly like a missing one.

tasks.title: Find one invoice by id or by number with an optional sender profile name
tasks.dod: Integration tests show the invoice is returned as stored with copied sender/customer details, lines, amounts, derived status and no bank fields, INV-0012 in two sender profiles without a sender profile name returns both candidates, and another Freelancer's invoice by id or number returns the same NOT_FOUND as a missing one.

tasks.title: Expose the overdue, Debtors, Expected payments and summary figures tools
tasks.dod: Integration tests through POST /api/mcp show list_overdue_invoices, list_debtors, list_expected_payments and get_summary_figures return the openapi Answer shapes for the AC-12 to AC-16 fixtures with today, timeZone and pageInfo, customer and sender names wrapped as freelancerText, and an invalid period returned as a VALIDATION tool error.

tasks.title: Expose the customers, invoice search and one-invoice tools
tasks.dod: Integration tests through POST /api/mcp show list_customers, search_invoices and get_invoice return the openapi Answer shapes, get_invoice includes the absolute /invoices/<id>/edit link and no bank fields, every Freelancer-entered field is a freelancerText wrapper, AC-20/AC-21 ambiguity returns candidates, and Freelancer A's key gets the identical NOT_FOUND for Freelancer B's invoice and Customer.

tasks.title: Add the Connect your AI settings page with setup steps, example prompts and a CopyButton
tasks.dod: Component tests show the Settings nav item Connect your AI linking to /settings/assistants, the three client tabs with snippets keeping the key in a user-level setting and a YOUR_KEY placeholder replaceable by a key prop, the three example prompts, and CopyButton's copied and clipboard-unavailable states; the page has a loading skeleton.

tasks.title: Build key creation, the one-time reveal, the key lists and revoke confirmation on Connect your AI
tasks.dod: Component tests cover SCR-03 default, empty, creating, key-created (reveal with copy and warning, snippets filled), validation and limit messages verbatim, create-failed, revoked, revoke-not-found and error, and SCR-04 default, cancelled, pending, success, not-found and rejected.

tasks.title: Show the overdue-rule notice and the Connect your AI entry point on the dashboard
tasks.dod: Tests show getDashboardNoticeState is true until dismissOverdueRuleNotice runs (repeat dismiss returns ok), the notice states default, dismissed and dismiss-failed, the entry point renders while hasUsedAnyPersonalKey is false and never after a key passed a key check even if every key is revoked, in the order setup alert, notice, entry point.

tasks.title: Add Personal keys, weekly usage and the time zone to the data export and verify deletion removes them
tasks.dod: Integration tests show export version 2.1 lists each key's name, createdAt, lastUsedAt, revokedAt and usageWeeks plus user.timeZone and overdueNoticeDismissedAt and never digest, lastFour, activeNameKey, id or the key, and deleting the account removes every key and usage row in the one transaction.

tasks.title: Prove Assistant-dashboard parity, day boundaries, tenant isolation and the latency budget end to end
tasks.dod: CI integration tests show every tool figure equals the dashboard to the cent over a seeded multi-currency fixture, the AC-23 and AC-23b instants agree between dashboard and tools under a fake clock, Freelancer A's key never reveals any of Freelancer B's records through any tool, and the aggregates stay within 1.5 s and lists within 800 ms for a 5,000-invoice Freelancer.

tasks.title: Store issue and due dates as calendar days and compare every period and the overdue rule by calendar day
tasks.dod: Review F-02/F-03 fixed per the owner's decision: the editor sends issueDate/dueDate as yyyy-MM-dd and the services store them as T00:00:00Z; a paired up/down migration backfills existing rows to the calendar day in each owner's saved time zone; the overdue rule, dashboard/Expected-payments period filters and Assistant search filters all compare by calendar day (::date / LocalDate); data-model.md and sad §8 record the storage meaning. Tests: a due date picked as local midnight in Europe/Kyiv is not overdue on its own due date and reports the picked day; an America/New_York 'this month' includes the invoice due on the 1st and excludes the 1st of next month — dashboard and Assistant agree.

tasks.title: Keep the stored status through an editor save of a derived-overdue invoice
tasks.dod: Review F-01 fixed: the editor receives the stored status (the derived badge kept separate) and updateInvoice never persists a derived OVERDUE for a stored PENDING invoice (refusesManualStatus applied on this path). Integration test: load editor data for a past-due PENDING invoice, save it through updateInvoice, the stored status is still PENDING; moving the due date into the future makes it not overdue.

tasks.title: Refuse JSON-RPC batches and cap the MCP request body before the transport
tasks.dod: Review F-04 fixed: the route reads the body with a small size cap, answers an array with 400 / -32600 'batches are not accepted' (as openapi.yaml says) before any tool runs, and hands parsedBody to transport.handleRequest; maxRequestBodySize is set on the transport. Pipeline test: a 2-element batch is refused and runs no tool; an oversized body is refused.

tasks.title: Build dashboard and invoice-list periods from the account time zone
tasks.dod: Review F-05 fixed: the dashboard and invoices pages build presets/defaults from actingFreelancerFromSession().timeZone, the tz cookie only seeds the first visit (ADR-0006). Test: with a cookie zone different from the saved zone, the dashboard 'this month' equals the Assistant's.

tasks.title: Match the contract's InvoiceCandidate and ServerFailure, report route failures, accept any-case Bearer, drop dead paging code
tasks.dod: Review F-06/F-08/F-13/F-14 fixed: AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE invoice candidates have the InvoiceCandidate shape (names as freelancerText) and the AC-20 test asserts senderProfile, customer and issueDate; the 500 body matches ServerFailure (or the contract is updated with the owner); the route catch calls Sentry.captureException; the Bearer match is case-insensitive; the unused paging helpers in lib/mcp/answers.ts and firstSuccessPending are removed.

tasks.title: Answer a key-check store failure with 503 and prove last use on tools/list and on a refused call
tasks.dod: Review F-09/F-10 fixed: a store error in the key check returns a distinct unavailable result mapped to the existing 503 without recordRefusedKeyCheck; the lastUsedAt write is best-effort and cannot refuse a valid key. Tests: a store failure answers 503 and records no refused check; lastUsedAt is set after tools/list and after the 61st (429) call.

tasks.title: Leave cancelled-only currencies out of summary currencies and dashboard tabs
tasks.dod: Review F-07 fixed: summary currencies and dashboard tabs use issued invoices only (status NOT IN DRAFT, CANCELLED). Test: a currency present only on a cancelled invoice yields no tab and no summary entry.

tasks.title: Guard the overdue literal scan without obfuscation and validate the real 2.1 export body
tasks.dod: Review F-11/F-16 fixed: OVERDUE_STATUS/toUpperCase and the invoiceStatusConfig cast are gone; display-only files use the plain literal and are allow-listed in the scan with a written reason, and the scan also catches OVERDUE_STATUS/toUpperCase in lib/services; the export test validates the real 2.1 body against a 2.1 export schema instead of reshaping it.

tasks.title: Polish the key-name hint, revoke focus and time-zone labels, and test the one-time reveal on remount
tasks.dod: Review F-15/F-16 fixed: SCR-03 shows the manifest hint under the key name; the revoke dialog keeps its title while closing and sends focus to a stable element after success; time-zone-settings imports TIME_ZONE_MESSAGE and builds zone labels once; component tests prove the full key is gone after remount and the limit alert clears after a revoke.

tasks.title: Add the e2e specs the test plan declares for the proxy, key flows, sign-in return, time zone and overdue surfaces
tasks.dod: Review F-12 fixed: every e2e / e2e-through-UI row in test-plan.md for AC-01, AC-02, AC-06, AC-09, AC-19, AC-22 and AC-24 has a spec under tests/e2e/ that runs green (real proxy refusal of session-only and Visitor calls; key visible once and gone after reload; revoke moves the row; sign-in returns to the invoice link; Kyiv zone saved on first visit; overdue shown on every surface); test-plan.md links each row to its spec.

tasks.title: Normalise legacy invoice dates lazily when the Freelancer time zone is first saved
tasks.dod: G-01 fixed per the owner decision: the calendar-day migration converts only rows whose owner has a saved valid zone (no UTC fallback, legacy values untouched otherwise); when User.timeZone goes NULL→value (first-visit seed or settings save) the same transaction normalises that Freelancer's legacy (non-UTC-midnight) issueDate/dueDate in that zone; data-model.md + sad §8 + the migration header describe the lazy path. Tests: a NULL-zone owner's rows survive the migration unchanged; the seed with a Kyiv cookie turns a Kyiv local-midnight due date into the picked day; a second save of a different zone changes no dates; UTC-midnight rows are never moved.

tasks.title: Build dashboard presets and the applied-range label in the account time zone
tasks.dod: G-02 fixed: dashboard presets come from the account zone (server-computed or zone passed to the client), the applied-range label/calendar shows the zone-local period days in any browser zone, and a failed actor lookup on the dashboard and invoices pages takes the load-error path (tests for each).

tasks.title: Keep request bodies out of Sentry, check Accept and Content-Type first, and put 413 and the batch refusal in the contract
tasks.dod: G-03 fixed: no Sentry capture on the JSON parse branch; 406/415 checked before the body is read (pipeline test pins 415 for a non-JSON content type); openapi.yaml lists 413 (64 KB cap) and the -32600 batch example; the oversized-body test asserts no tool ran and the limit-event count; the maxRequestBodySize comment says backstop.

tasks.title: Map a submitted OVERDUE back to PENDING only for a derived-overdue invoice
tasks.dod: G-04 fixed: statusToStoreOnSave changes a submitted OVERDUE to the stored PENDING only when the stored invoice is derived-overdue; tests cover past-due (kept PENDING) and not-yet-due (behaves as before this feature).

tasks.title: Give the no-zone, export-schema, revoke-title and overdue-surface tests teeth
tasks.dod: G-05 fixed: the no-zone fallback test pins the clock near a day edge and differs from Kyiv; recorded-values.ts header records the deliberate re-baseline; the AC-25 test runs assertMatchesContract on a populated export; the revoke-title assertion runs unconditionally and fails against the old title expression; the AC-24 e2e checks are scoped to the invoice row and assert no 'Pending'.

tasks.title: Keep unedited legacy invoice dates through an editor save, seed the zone from the editor, and accept only calendar-day strings on the server
tasks.dod: H-01, H-05, H-10 fixed: the (invoice-editor) layout mounts TimeZoneCookie; updateInvoice leaves issueDate/dueDate untouched when the submitted day equals the stored value's UTC day and the stored value is not a UTC midnight; an integration test (no saved zone, legacy Kyiv due date 2026-10-14T21:00Z, notes-only editor save, then the zone is saved) ends with due day 2026-10-15; the server-action and service schema accept only yyyy-MM-dd (Date branch moved to a client-only schema) with a test that a Date is refused; lazy normalisation has a NULL -> America/New_York case (2026-10-16T02:00Z becomes 2026-10-15).

tasks.title: Keep MCP request data out of Sentry transactions, report SDK failures, treat client aborts as client errors, and return the contract 405 body
tasks.dod: H-03, H-06, H-07, H-12 fixed: sentry.server.config.ts sets beforeSendTransaction to scrubMcpRequest and ignores incoming request bodies on /api/mcp, both unit-tested; transport.onerror reports to Sentry and no raw error text reaches the client; a body read that throws on client abort returns a client-error refusal without a Sentry report, tested; 405 returns the MethodNotAllowed JSON-RPC body from openapi.yaml and the test asserts it.

tasks.title: Label dashboard chart days as calendar days, resolve presets on the server, show the applied preset, and keep focus after a not-found revoke
tasks.dod: H-04, H-08, H-09, H-11 fixed: chart ticks and tooltip use formatStoredDay, with a component test under TZ=America/Los_Angeles showing Oct 1; preset clicks send ?preset=<name> resolved server-side in the account zone; the pressed preset is derived from appliedPeriod and today (custom fallback), tested after reload; the NOT_FOUND revoke branch moves focus to the heading, asserted via document.activeElement.

tasks.title: Bring the ADRs, contracts, data model, screens manifest and test plan in line with the fixes
tasks.dod: H-13 fixed: ADR-0006 amended (or ADR-0009 added) recording calendar-day storage and lazy normalisation with accepted risks; server-actions.md documents authenticatePersonalKey's unavailable result, the editor's stored status + derivedOverdue, and yyyy-MM-dd dates (also architecture-hardening server-actions.md:60); openapi.yaml pipeline step 2 and LimitStoreUnavailable cover the key-check 503; data-model.md:21 note updated; screens.md SCR-07 default updated; test-plan.md rows added for calendar days, the migration, lazy normalisation, batch 400/413, 406/415 order and account-zone presets, updated_at bumped.

tasks.title: Compare an editor save against the dates the editor loaded, lock the row with its owner, and make the normalisation race test deterministic
tasks.dod: I-01, I-04, I-05 fixed. The editor save payload carries the stored issue/due instants the editor was built from (loadedIssueDate/loadedDueDate ISO); updateInvoice keeps the value re-read under FOR UPDATE when the loaded value is not a UTC midnight and the submitted day equals utcDateToDay(loaded), otherwise writes the submitted day. An integration test at action or service level: no saved zone, legacy Kyiv due date 2026-10-14T21:00Z and issue date 2026-09-30T21:00Z, seedTimeZoneIfEmpty(Europe/Kyiv) runs, then a notes-only save submits '2026-10-14' / '2026-09-30' with the loaded instants -> due date stays 2026-10-15T00:00Z and issue date 2026-10-01T00:00Z; a stale-tab case (zone saved by another request after load) passes the same way. The FOR UPDATE raw query joins SenderProfile with "userId" = ${userId} (as numbering.ts) and the S-05 owner-in-where test asserts it. The race test in calendar-days.test.ts replaces the 1.5 s sleep with an explicit barrier (pg_locks / pg_stat_activity poll or injected hook) and adds the 'normalisation committed before the save read' ordering as its own case. The comment at invoices.ts:519-525, ADR-0009 :41, contracts/server-actions.md:163, data-model.md:104 and screens.md:292 describe the loaded-dates comparison accurately.

tasks.title: Answer an SDK catch-all failure with the contract ServerFailure and scrub /api/mcp/ with a trailing slash
tasks.dod: I-02, I-03 fixed. When the SDK's catch-all answer carries error.data, the route reports it to Sentry once and returns the contract ServerFailure (HTTP 500, JSON-RPC -32603, 'Something went wrong in Invoice Forge. Try again.', id null); plain client refusals the SDK raises keep their 4xx. tests/unit/api/mcp-route-transport-errors.test.ts asserts the status and the full body. isMcpUrl normalises trailing slashes (pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') === '/api/mcp'), scrubMcpRequest reuses isMcpUrl, and tests/unit/config/mcp-sentry-transactions.test.ts covers '/api/mcp/' and '/api/mcp/?x=1'. openapi.yaml 400 / 500 descriptions and the test-plan row match.

tasks.title: Ignore a save that resolves after the editor was reset, keep a number or status edited while a save is in flight, move LoadedDates into the store types, and list the loaded-dates tests in the test plan
tasks.dod: K-01, K-02, K-03, J-02 fixed. The editor store holds a session token that initialize() and reset() change; saveInvoice captures it, and applySavedInvoice / handleSaveFailure return without writing when it no longer matches. A store test starts a save, calls reset() and initialize({}), resolves the save, and asserts invoiceId, invoiceNumber and loadedDates are still unset. applySavedInvoice keeps an invoiceNumber or status the Freelancer changed while the save was in flight (compare with submitted, as storedOrEdited does for dates) and the form stays dirty; the in-flight component test covers both fields. interface LoadedDates lives in store/invoice-editor-store/types.ts with imports at the top; helpers.ts imports it from there. test-plan.md has AC-12 rows (integration and component) for: zone seeded after the editor loaded, stale tab, second save in one session, forged or malformed loaded dates, the commit-before-read ordering, and the editor sending / keeping-in-flight / clearing-on-reset loaded dates, naming their spec files.

tasks.title: Scrub /api/mcp requests whose path has repeated slashes
tasks.dod: J-01 fixed. isMcpUrl collapses runs of '/' and '\\' and strips a trailing slash before comparing with '/api/mcp', so '//api/mcp', '/api//mcp' and '/api/mcp//' all match for scrubMcpRequest, ignoreIncomingRequestBody and beforeSendTransaction. tests/unit/config/mcp-sentry-transactions.test.ts covers '//api/mcp' and '/api//mcp' for the scrub and the body ignore, and still refuses '/api/mcpx' and '/api/mcp/other'.

tasks.title: Show a stale save failure, keep an empty number after a sender switch in flight, guard the sender hint and Retry with the session token, test the isSaving guard, and correct T46's ACs
tasks.dod: M-02, L-02, M-03, M-04, L-01 fixed. handleSaveFailure for a stale token still shows toast.error(result.error || 'Error saving invoice.') without a Retry action and writes no state; the stale-failure component test asserts the toast. applySavedInvoice keeps the current invoiceNumber when state.formData.senderProfileId differs from submitted.senderProfileId; the in-flight test covers a sender switch and asserts the number stays ''. A test starts save A, calls reset() and initialize(), starts save B, resolves A, and asserts isSaving is still true. selectSenderProfile drops the invoiceNumberHint write and the toast Retry closure no-ops when the session token captured at its start no longer matches; both have tests. T46 acs in tasks.json are AC-12 and AC-19; the test at invoice-editor-store-loaded-dates.test.tsx:197 no longer cites AC-21; tasks/tracker.md notes the T46 AC correction (commit trailers stay).

tasks.title: Scrub percent-encoded /api/mcp paths
tasks.dod: M-01 fixed. isMcpUrl runs decodeURIComponent on the pathname before collapsing runs of '/' and '\\', and treats a URL whose path fails to decode as MCP (fail closed). tests/unit/config/mcp-sentry-transactions.test.ts covers '/api/%6Dcp' and 'https://app.example/%61pi/mcp' for the scrub and the body ignore, and still refuses '/api/mcpx' and '/api/mcp/other'.

tasks.title: Give the sender-hint reset test teeth, block Retry while a save is in flight, test Retry in the same session, and list the stale-session cases in the test plan
tasks.dod: N-01..N-04 fixed. (N-01) The 'hint after reset()' test re-initializes with senderProfileId 'profile-b' and an empty number before the hint resolves, asserts invoiceNumberHint is undefined, and fails if the token check at use-invoice-editor-store.ts:314 is removed. (N-02) The FAILED-toast Retry is a no-op while isSaving is true; a test with a save in flight shows Retry does not call the save action again. (N-03) A test fails a save with FAILED, invokes Retry in the same session with no reset, and asserts the save action ran twice; it fails if the guard is inverted or emptied. (N-04) test-plan.md's AC-12 stale-session row lists the late-failure toast without Retry, the in-flight sender switch, the hint and Retry guards, the isSaving guard and the same-session Retry.
